answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch auctions 200 slots; sealed bids pick winners, and each winning bid locks a 40-credit copper deposit for 20 epochs, non-transferable. A sybil operator must outbid honest agents for every fake, so bulk buying piles locked cost into a dune: 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits locked 20 epochs. An honest agent pays 40 once, stays flexible as a willow under one cost, and keeps undiluted rewards.
